purpose.summary: Guidance for the design and programming of Bosch web banners, extending the Bosch UI Kit and supporting consistent web banner style across digital channels.
scope: Use of templates, libraries, and related design principles

guidance.rule: Treat this page as an extension of the Bosch UI Kit for the design and programming of web banners.
guidance.rationale: The guide exists to ensure a consistent style and appearance of web banners across digital channels.

guidance.rule: Each product owner is responsible for checking legal and data-protection requirements in the relevant market.
Use Sketch for efficient Bosch web banner design when following this guide.
Install and use the Web banner design template alongside the Core and Icon Overrides Library.
Check for updates regularly to keep files current.
Refer to installation and library/template usage guidance under Start Designing.
Send feature requests and bug reports for the Digital Design System or Frontend Kit to the digital expert team via Jira; send design feedback/questions to support.design@bosch.com.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.summary: Positions web banner basics as an extension of the Bosch UI Kit for design and programming, with the goal of consistent banner appearance across digital channels.

sections.title: Legal and data-protection responsibility
sections.summary: Product owners must check market-specific legal requirements with legal and data-protection contacts before implementation.

sections.title: Essentials at a glance
sections.summary: Provides quick access to downloadable resources, design principles, templates, and animation principles.

sections.title: Additional instructions
sections.summary: Recommends Sketch and specifies required libraries/templates, update hygiene, and references for Start Designing guidance.

sections.title: Support and feedback
sections.summary: Routes feature requests and bugs through Jira and provides the design support email for feedback, questions, and draft checks.

checklist.action: Confirm whether the banner uses the Bosch UI Kit and this web banner extension.
Check market-specific legal and data-protection requirements.
Use Sketch for banner design when following the guide.
Install and use the Web banner design template with Core and Icon Overrides Library.
Check for template and library updates regularly.
Refer to Start Designing for installation and usage details.
Route DDS or Frontend Kit feature requests and bugs via Jira.
Send design questions or draft checks to support.design@bosch.com.
